reviewer: independent read-only G7 arm-specific output-contract review

findings.title: G7 model-output stage parser accepted malformed nested V/L/U fields
findings.evidence: Before this repair, public_tool_loop(..., checkpoint=true) accepted a checkpoint payload containing the diagnostic stages object instead of rejecting it; a direct MockLLMProvider probe returned accepted=true with top-level stages. The immutable protocol-corrected checkpoint artifact contains 184 rows, of which 128 include stages even though the checkpoint contract has only decision, affected_claim_ids, revised_claim, and supporting_evidence. This historical artifact is preserved and remains non-confirmatory.
findings.remediation: Enforce exact arm-specific top-level output keys: checkpoint outputs must exclude stages, diagnostic outputs must include stages; preserve malformed outputs through the bounded format-retry path and never rewrite historical checkpoint artifacts.
